source: Sources: Costco CFO, 2015 earnings call (Seattle Times); WSJ 2018

scenes.text: Case file: a chicken that hasn't changed its price since 2009.
scenes.say: Case file: a chicken that hasn't changed its price since two thousand nine.
scenes.head: CASE FILE: $4.99

scenes.text: Suspect: Costco. Price then: $4.99. Price now: $4.99.
scenes.say: Suspect: Costco. Price then: four ninety-nine. Price now: four ninety-nine.
scenes.head: THE SUSPECT

scenes.text: Clue one. In 2015, their finance chief said they'd eat $30 to $40 million a year to hold it.
scenes.say: Clue one. In twenty fifteen, their finance chief said they'd eat thirty to forty million dollars a year to hold it.
scenes.head: CLUE #1

scenes.text: Clue two. The chickens sit all the way at the back of the store.
scenes.head: CLUE #2

scenes.text: So you walk past everything else first. Wait a second...
scenes.head: WAIT A SECOND...

scenes.text: The chicken isn't the product. It's the bait!
scenes.head: CASE CLOSED

scenes.text: So... what did YOU leave with last time?
scenes.head: WHAT DID YOU LEAVE WITH?
